body:
Pass 8. Metric work verified clean last pass; C1/C2 closure confirmed.

New p1, bd-01KZXEVFW3X074685EXWJZNP2D, raised now because compiler.R is still untouched. Epic 4 is claimed with Epic 0A open - mote ready agrees Epic 4 is not ready. That would be procedural except the ordering is load-bearing: Epic 4 acceptance "execution receipt records the actual lowering" is unfalsifiable today. geometry/evaluate_geometry/.run_geometry_compiler accept no normalizer/transform/reducer, .compiler_plan_id has them as defaults only, and the receipt hardcodes the same values - so there is exactly one possible plan and no test can tell "reads the plan" from "constant that matches".

The only things that make lowering vary are the eight edge-operation exports plus .evaluate_edge_operation, which Epic 0A must wire up or delete. Keep them and Epic 4 gets a free acceptance test (two plans differing only in normalizer must give different receipts and different numbers). Delete them and Epic 4 should drop those fields from plan identity instead of carrying dead schema forward.

Baseline to verify against when Epic 4 lands: .compile_effect_task still has one call site (compiler.R:412, inside .compiler_plan_id, whose entire return is a digest), receipt block at compiler.R:690-699 still a literal.
